title: c00lkidd Idle Laugh
blurb: Somewhere off-screen, a giggling Roblox killer is having a wonderful time, and you have no idea how far away he is. c00lkidd began life as a legendary Roblox exploiter account and has since been rebuilt as a playable killer in Forsaken, where the idle laugh is a mechanic as much as a flourish — you hear it, you cannot locate it, and you immediately start making bad decisions. That is the oldest trick in horror design, ported into Roblox with a red-and-green cartoon child doing the honours.
origin: c00lkidd's idle laugh from the Roblox game Forsaken.
